messages:
Ravi S: Quick check for SI cert cohort next week — classroom + lab access, badge issuance, and joint blog timing.
Amira: Classroom booked Mon/Tue 10-3 PT. Need final attendee list and repo access.
Carlos M: I have 12 SI engineers confirmed. Will send names + emails by EOD.
Priya: Badge platform needs participant emails and a short cert description (50-60 words). Also confirm logo usage rights.
Ravi S: Draft cert blurb: "Redwood SI Certified: Field-Ready Inference Deployment — covers runtime ops, marketplace integration, and on-prem security controls." Thoughts?
Amira: Good start. Add "KV cache and fallback policies" to make it explicit.
Carlos M: Can we include a one-hour hands-on for marketplace listing? Partners asked for that.
Priya: Yes — add a lab module: "Marketplace listing & privacy checklist". I can author the exercise.
training-bot: Reminder: upload training deck v1 to /training/si/cohort-3 by 17:00 or send a comment to create a new draft.
Ravi S: Action items:
- Carlos: attendee names + emails by 18:00
- Priya: cert blurb + badge asset request to design by 16:00
- Amira: confirm lab image + creds rotation schedule
- Carlos/Amira: decide blog co-author and publish ETA (opt: same week as cohort)
Amira: Security wants a short annex showing PII controls for the lab. I'll loop in SecOps.
Carlos M: Noted. I'll surface that to the SI leads and ask them for any constraints.
Priya: I'll draft the badge text and ping Design for SVG today.
Ravi S: Great. If we can get all assets tomorrow we can do a soft announcement with the partner two days after cohort end. Keeping updates in this thread. :rocket:
